threads.body: [Testing] In `testLatestDeps` builds, `orLatest()` selects the HTTP `#+` pin, which is still `1.4.2`, so `pekko2Test` loses HTTP 2.x coverage while retaining Pekko Stream 2.x and the 2.x binding shim. Keep `orLatest("2.+")` for the HTTP dependency to select the existing `2.0.0-M2` pin. Apply the same change to `pekko-http_3` at line 148 for `pekko2Scala3Test`.

This replaces `PekkoIgnoredTypesConfigurer` `org.apache.pekko.dispatch.Dispatcher$$anon$1` use there is a sublcass of `Mailbox`. Executor configuration has changed so now `Dispatcher$$anon$1` gets wrapped into `PekkoForkJoinTask` which triggers undesired context propagation.
now regular tests test 1.x and `pekko2Test` tests 2 to latest
